prompt:
Our internal AI skill marketplace is preparing its Q4 2024 batch for publication review. We've received 6 new skill submissions located in `marketplace/submissions/batch_2024_Q4/`. Before approving any of them, the trust & safety team needs a full validation quality audit — we've had too many incidents where skills claimed to have passing tests but the 'tests' were completely fake.

Please audit all 6 capsule submissions in that batch directory. For each one, analyze whether its validation command actually tests real behavior or just creates an illusion of coverage. Produce a consolidated report file called `validation_audit_report.json` that covers all 6 capsules with: the detected quality rating for each one, a breakdown of what kind of validation patterns were found (genuine assertions vs. hollow outputs vs. commented-out tests), and specific evidence for your findings.

The trust & safety team will use this report to decide which submissions to reject outright and which to send back for remediation.
